correctness.rationale: PASS: Characteristic-two matrix squaring is I+N^2. Literal strict-upper-triangular coordinate multiplication yields u=ab,v=bc,w=cd,x=af+ec,y=bg+fd,z=ai+eg+hd, with free top-right entry j. This proves the image restrictions v=0=>uw=0 and v!=0,u=w=0=>vz=xy and explicit witnesses give sufficiency for every field of characteristic 2. Conditioning on v!=0 versus v=0 and on (u,w),(x,y),z gives the complete listed target-root fibers: q^3(q-1), q^4(q-1), q^4(q^2-1), 3q^5(q-1), q^5(5q-4) or 0 in the exact stated strata. Fresh independent enumeration over F2 and F4 used literal nine input coordinates (restoring the tenth free field coordinate), separate polynomial-basis multiplication and all q^6 targets; every fiber agreed (64 and 4096 targets; image 52 and 3376; sum of root multiplicities 1024 and 1048576). The all-q result follows from the field-algebra partition, not those finite tests.
residual_risks: Image criterion holds for any field of characteristic 2; cardinality and fibers require q finite power of 2.
Finite q=2,4 checks are corroboration, not universal proof.
Priority of full target-root fiber distribution remains a best-of-knowledge assessment.

originality.rationale: PASS (best of knowledge): Earlier 2026-10-13 RESULT.md proves the identical six-coordinate square-membership criterion and polynomial image size, and 2026-10-25 proves the analogous criterion for all primes p on UT_(p+3); neither gives preimage multiplicities. Dolfi, Singh and Yadav (2019) investigate power images, cite the same 52 and 3376 examples and provide broad image estimates, not the complete q-uniform distribution of each individual root fiber. The genuinely additional submitted claim is the exact seven-stratum target-by-target root-multiplicity partition, not the known membership test or known small-q image totals. Residual risk of a general nilpotent root-count theorem implying this exact distribution remains.

Existing same-object membership and exact image polynomial are NOT independently novel; pass only for the complete root-fiber refinement.
